fields.options: A DocType is only manageable in a Cloudverce User Group's Permission Matrix if it actually has a shortcut in an included Workspace's sidebar -- add one with the "+ Add DocType" button on the Cloudverce User Group form (no need to open the Workspace Editor). Merely belonging to an installed app/module is NOT enough by itself. Every app, module and workspace below is included by default -- uncheck a row only if you want its workspaces excluded as a shortcut source. New apps/modules/workspaces are auto-added (checked) on every migrate.

fields.description: Uncheck an app to exclude all of its Workspaces as a source of sidebar-shortcut DocTypes. Frappe itself is always excluded and never listed here.
fields.label: Included Apps

fields.description: Uncheck a module to exclude its Workspaces as a shortcut source, even if its app is included.
fields.label: Included Modules

fields.description: Uncheck a workspace to stop its sidebar shortcuts from being manageable (Permission Matrix) or toggleable (Navigation Visibility) from Cloudverce User Group, even if its module is included.
fields.label: Workspace Sidebar
